scripts.build:sidecars: cd src-tauri && triple=$(rustc -vV | awk '/host:/ {print $2}') && mkdir -p bin && for sidecar in kota-bbs kota-agent-bus kota-bartender kota-ember; do : > "bin/$sidecar-$triple"; done && cargo build --release --bin kota-bbs --bin kota-agent-bus --bin kota-bartender --bin kota-ember && for sidecar in kota-bbs kota-agent-bus kota-bartender kota-ember; do cp "target/release/$sidecar" "bin/$sidecar-$triple" && chmod +x "bin/$sidecar-$triple" && test -s "bin/$sidecar-$triple"; done
scripts.build:sidecars:dev: cd src-tauri && triple=$(rustc -vV | awk '/host:/ {print $2}') && mkdir -p bin && for sidecar in kota-bbs kota-agent-bus kota-bartender kota-ember; do : > "bin/$sidecar-$triple"; done && cargo build --bin kota-bbs --bin kota-agent-bus --bin kota-bartender --bin kota-ember && for sidecar in kota-bbs kota-agent-bus kota-bartender kota-ember; do cp "target/debug/$sidecar" "bin/$sidecar-$triple" && chmod +x "bin/$sidecar-$triple" && test -s "bin/$sidecar-$triple"; done
